name: Snake Bite First Aid
overview: Snake Bite Emergency Care is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include immediate action can prevent complications; call emergency services for severe presentations. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.

steps.title: Move to safety
steps.description: Keep victim calm and still to slow venom spread.

steps.title: Immobilize limb
steps.description: Keep bitten area at or below heart level with splint if possible.

steps.title: Call emergency services
steps.description: Transport to hospital with antivenom capability immediately.

steps.title: Monitor vital signs
steps.description: Watch for swelling, breathing difficulty, or altered consciousness.

donts: Do not cut wound or suck venom
Do not use unproven herbal remedies

faq.question: Can I rely on this snake-bite information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

medicalDisclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider.
